In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Supply carrier/Legends|supply carrier]] was transporting material near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karatha]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces from [[Eyrie Base]] [[Raid on an Imperial supply carrier|attempted]] to hijack the carrier, but were unsuccessful.<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower|reprint=1}}</ref>
